name: Weekly database backup

# Every Sunday 20:00 UTC (= Monday 01:30 in Sri Lanka). Saves backups/sinsubz-DATE.json in this PRIVATE repo
# (newest 8 kept). Needs the secret ADMIN_KEY. Run by hand: Actions -> Weekly database backup -> Run workflow.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 20 * * 0"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  backup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Back up Redis
        env:
          ADMIN_KEY: ${{ secrets.ADMIN_KEY }}
        run: node scripts/backup.js
      - name: Commit the backup
        run: |
          git config user.name "sinsubz-backup"
          git config user.email "backup@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add backups
          git commit -m "Weekly backup" || echo "nothing to commit"
          git pull --rebase origin main || true
          git push origin HEAD:main
